name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text:
**Decision:** Use the kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript tool to auto-generate transcripts for all pending videos, then feed those transcripts into eA9Zf to extract the top 3 contradictions.

This is the fastest path to +5% daily coverage because it automates the two slowest steps: transcription and contradiction mining. The trade-off is accepting imperfect transcripts—YouTube’s auto-captions are error-prone—but eA9Zf’s contradiction extraction is robust enough to handle noise. The alternative—manual transcription—would bottleneck progress at 1-2 videos/day.

name: Scriv
text: The kimtaeyoon83 tool risks pulling low-quality transcripts—garbled speech, ads, or non-English segments—that’ll break eA9Zf’s contradiction extraction. A safer path: manually verify transcripts for 10% of videos first; if error rate >10%, reject the tool. Settle it with a 24-hour test batch.

name: Chisel
text:
We should run Scriv's 24-hour test batch to manually verify transcripts for 10% of videos. This is the best option because it balances the need for speed with the risk of low-quality transcripts breaking eA9Zf's contradiction extraction. By doing so, we're accepting the trade-off of a short delay in favor of ensuring the quality of our transcripts, which is crucial for accurate contradiction extraction and ultimately achieving our goal of pushing link coverage toward 100%. This cautious approach will help us avoid potential downstream problems and ensure the reliability of our results.

name: Sift
text: The 24-hour test batch still lets the kimtaeyoon83 tool’s low-quality transcripts slip through if the 10% sample misses the worst cases. Instead, run a 24-hour *parallel* test: auto-generate transcripts for all videos, then manually verify the top 10% most error-prone ones (flagged by eA9Zf’s confidence scores). Settle it by comparing coverage speed and contradiction extraction accuracy between the two methods.
